Commentary.Commentary: That concludes this game. The action continues in the World Cup. England will take on Afghansitan in the second match of Group 1. Switch and tabs and join us there. Cheers from here.

Kane Williamson, the skipper of New Zealand says it was an outstanding day. Adds Allen and Conway set it up and the bowlers were great. Mentions everybody has their roles, they wanted to get off to a good start and go through the gears and they managed to do that well.

Aaron Finch, the captain of Australia says New Zealand were all over them right from the start and they were outplayed by them. Adds Finn Allen went off to a flier. Shares they were slightly off and the net run rate took the hammering. Reckons they are playing Sri Lanka next and they need to win everything and have some luck on their side

Devon Conway is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH. He says it was a special performance. Applauds the way Allen started the game. Says Allen is young but he is explosive. On his innings, he just tried to time the ball well. Shares that it means a lot to beat Australia in Australia and this win will help to gather momentum.
...Presentation coming up...

For the Kiwis, it is a complete performance. First, with the bat, it was Allen at the top, Conway played throughout and then Neesham added the finishing touch and then the bowlers did their job. Mitchell Santner and Southee were brilliant and the rest continued the good work. A morale boosting win for the Kiwis who have struggled against the Aussies in recent times but here have outplayed them totally.

To be honest, 200 was way too much and on this wicket. It gets even more difficult when you lose your top three in the Powerplay and from there on, Australia just never recovered. They kept losing wickets and in the end, have fallen way, way short of the total.
A thumping win for the Kiwis. Not only do they get the two points but this win will boost their net run rate massively. Still, very early in the tournament but that can always come into contention.

OUT! IN THE AIR AND TAKEN! This is full and on off. Cummins gets low as he looks to slog-sweep but gets a top edge and Devon Conway, the keeper doesn't have to move much to take the skier. A big defeat for Australia. New Zealand win by 89 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: This is full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
A short ball,, outside off. Cummins stands tall as he looks to ramp it over but misses.
On the pads, this is clipped to deep square leg for one.

OUT! TIMBER! Two for Boult now. A knuckle ball this time, length and around leg. Zampa makes room to drive but misses and the ball hits the leg pole. This is going to be a very big defeat for the Aussies.
Bangs a bouncer on middle. Zampa looks to pull but misses.
OUT! BOWLED! Trent Boult gets his first! Mitchell Starc gets his own medicine! A yorker on middle. Starc fails to dig it out and the ball hits the base of middle.
Outside off, this is hit through covers for one.
A length ball, outside off, Starc looks to drive but misses.
Very full and around off, Cummins drives it to long off for a single.
A yorker, following Cummins on the leg side. Kept out.
SIX! Short in length and on the hips. Cummins thumps it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball, outside off. Cummins punches on the up and over covers and the ball races into the fence.
Full and on middle. Cummins chips it to long off for one.
A slower short ball on middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for one.
Leg bye! This is very full and on the pads. Cummins misses his whip and it goes off the pads on the off side for a leg bye.
Wide! Bowls a slower ball that is angling way outside off. Cummins leaves it alone.
On a length and on off, Starc drills it to mid off for one more.
On a length and outside off, heaved to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A slower full ball, outside off. Cummins swings across and misses.
This one goes away, outside off. Starc has a poke at it but misses.
Very full and around off, Cummins lofts it to long off for a single.
Full ball on off, Starc pushes to long on for one.

OUT! TIMBER! This time Maxwell misses and Sodhi strikes. One shot too many by Maxwell! A floated ball, full and around leg. Maxwell again tries to switch hit but misses and the ball hits the stumps. Australia might have just given up at this point now.
On middle, this is hit to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Wide! A slower one down the leg side. Cummins looks to pull but misses.
Flighted, full and was the googly, pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball, outside off, worked to mid-wicket for a single.
Lockie Ferguson tries the slower one, this is just around off. Pat Cummins swings and misses. The ball goes over the off pole. That was close.
FOUR! Off the mark! Short of a length and on off. Pat Cummins pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary.
A slower bouncer, outside off. Pat Cummins tries to dab it away but misses.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Another one goes and New Zealand are all over the hosts! On a length and outside off at 144 clicks. Wade looks to push, gets an outside edge and Devon Conway gobbles it up. Australia need 119 runs in 46 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Lockie Ferguson

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, kept out.
Outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Maxwell reverse paddles it to deep cover. One.
Flatter and on middle, skids through. Maxwell hits it back to the bowler. Maxwell is livid with himself.
Quicker one on off, pushed to cover.
SIX! Why not if you are getting the result? What a player! Tossed up, on middle. Maxwell switch hits it over covers, all the way for a six.
Maxwell is trying to be cheeky more often now! Around off, Maxwell reverse paddles but finds point.
Floated ball on middle. Maxwell drills it to long on for one.
Maxwell again goes for the reverse sweep but miscues it to cover.
FOUR! Need more! Well played! This is full and outside off. Maxwell reverse sweeps it fine past short third man for a boundary.
Tossed up, outside off, driven to long off for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! That's the end of David! Tries to clear the same region but finds the fielder. Mitchell Santner drops it short, and outside off. David rocks back and pulls but finds James Neesham at deep mid-wicket. Australia are falling over. 133 runs needed in 58 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Powered! Tossed up, outside off. David slogs it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Up and over! Maxwell makes room, this is tossed up on off, it is lofted over cover for a boundary.
On middle, this is swept through square leg for one.
On off, this is hit down to long off for one.
On off, this lands and turns. David looks to defend, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
On middle, defended.
Maxwell plays the reverse sweep, but it goes off the inner half through point for one.
Another single as this is hit down to long off.
On off, this is hit to long off for one.
Shorter and outside off, David cuts it past point and takes two. He is off the mark.
On off, this is guided to point.
Tim David walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a stunner! An absolute stunner! Take a bow Glenn Phillips! He is so good in the outfield! This is slower, it is tossed up outside off. Stoinis makes room and lofts it over cover. Glenn Phillips in the deep runs to his right, he makes a lot of ground and then dives full stretch to take a stunner.
Commentary.Howout: c Glenn Phillips b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: So clever! Slows it up and bowls it outside off. Stoinis looks to drag it but misses.

FOUR! Over the cover fielder and a welcome boundary. Brings up the 50 and Australia need a lot more of these. On middle, Glenn Maxwell plays the reverse sweep, he hits it over the cover fielder and it goes into the fence.
Flatter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Maxwell makes room! He slaps it down to long off for another single. Singles won't harm New Zealand.
A single as this is pushed down to long on.
Two! Shorter and on the pads, this is pulled wide of deep mid-wicket for two.
Flatter and angled into the pads, defended.
A single to end another tidy over! Shorter and outside off, this is played through point for one.
Really well bowled! Slows it up, lands it wide outside off as he sees Stoinis shape up for the sweep, Stoinis looks to cut but chops it to point.
Just the one! Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, Stoinis looks to cut but this goes off the underedge towards short fine leg for one.
Almost! Stoinis looks to sweep but this way too full outside off. Marcus Stoinis misses.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A dot to end the Powerplay and Australia in all sorts of trouble after it. On off, this is pushed to cover.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
Angled into the pads. Stoinis works it towards mid-wicket and takes one.
On off, this is pushed towards cover.
A single as this is worked towards mid on.
A dot to end! On the pads, this is kept out.
Marcus Stoinis walks out now.

OUT! TAKEN! Australia are in dire straits now. They are well and truly on the back foot! Marsh goes. Southee gets another one. The slower one, on middle, Marsh is way too early in the loft. He hits it high up in the air towards deep mid-wicket. James Neesham takes a good catch.
Commentary.Howout: c James Neesham b Tim Southee

Commentary.Commentary: A huge shout from Southee! He believes that is out but turned down! A slower one on off, Mitchell Marsh looks to go downtown but this lands and jags back in. It hits Marsh high on the pad.
Another one on a length. It is kept out.
FOUR! Nicely played! Southee might be wondering, how did he get that there! This is around middle and off, Marsh just helps it on its way over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Glenn Maxwell is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Mitchell Santner ends the over with a wicket! The Aussie skipper falls. Not sure if this shot was needed to be honest! Finch makes room and Santner goes full and on off, Finch looks to go over covers but fails to get under the ball. He hits it straight to Williamson who takes a nice catch at cover. Timely wicket as the momentum seemed to be shifting.
Commentary.Howout: c Kane Williamson b Mitchell Santner

Commentary.Commentary: On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
SIX! That is the shot of the game so far! Wow! Marsh makes room. This is tossed up on off, Marsh lifts it over the cover fence for a big one.
Flatter and angled into the pads, Marsh looks to push at it, he gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! Swept! That is the go-to shot for Marsh against spinners! Around off, Marsh manages to drag it past square leg and this one races away to the fence.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
Mitchell Santner to bowl now.
A dot to end! So after going for 10 from the first two, Boult has pulled things back nicely! Length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
Two more! Outside off, Finch guides it past point. It is just the two.
On off, Finch pushes it to cover again.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed to cover.
FOUR! 10 from the first two balls! A low full toss, Finch stands and just times it down the ground. This one races away to the fence.

SIX! That is a massive hit! Wow! That should break the shackles and also maybe settle the nerves a touch! Finch makes room, this is on a length and on middle, it is smashed over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Perfect start to the over.
A single to end! A good start by Tim Southee! On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
Firmly driven but for no runs! Fuller and on off, Finch pushes it towards mid off.
Half an appeal but that is going down leg! On middle, this lands and jags back in. Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.

Yes, no, wait a single in the end! The Aussies just seem nervos at the moment! Length and on off, this is guided to point. Marsh wants one but Finch is late to take off. A misfield and hence, Finch goes for it.
Good length and on middle, defended.
Mitchell Marsh walks out to the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! That is a massive wicket, Tim Southee gets the best batter of the Australian line-up on his very first delivery. This is on a length and around off, Warner looks to pull but the length was not the right one for that shot. It hits the pads, then takes the inside edge of the bat and then onto the stumps. New Zealand well and truly on top now. The most unluckiest way David Warner would have got out.
SWING AND A MISS! Boult with another beauty! On a length and outside off, angling across and shaping a bit away. Finch gets on his toes as he looks to punch but misses.
On a length and on middle. Warner tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! EDGED AND JUST WIDE! Boult almost had Warner here. What a delivery! Absolute beauty. This is full, angled on middle and makes it to shape away. Warner looks to work with the angle but gets an outside edge and the ball just flies wide of first slip. A boundary to third man.
On a length and outside off, outswinger again. Warner punches it straight to cover.
A length ball, outside off, this time Boult gets the away movement. Warner looks to push at it but misses.
Boult starts with a full ball, outside off, not much swing for him. Warner taps it to point.
